# anthropic_claude_code_usage_report (Data Source)

Daily Claude Code productivity metrics per user or API key for one UTC day. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_claude_code_usage_report" "yesterday" {
  date = "2026-01-15"
}

output "sessions_by_actor" {
  value = {
    for r in data.anthropic_claude_code_usage_report.yesterday.records :
    coalesce(r.actor_email, r.actor_api_key_name) => r.num_sessions
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `date` (String) UTC day to report, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) One row per actor; remote and local usage are separate rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `actor_api_key_name` (String) API key name; null for user actors.
- `actor_email` (String) User email; null for API key actors.
- `actor_type` (String) `user_actor` or `api_actor`.
- `commits` (Number) Commits created through Claude Code.
- `customer_type` (String) `api` or `subscription`.
- `is_remote` (Boolean) Whether the usage came from remote (web) sessions.
- `lines_added` (Number) Lines of code added.
- `lines_removed` (Number) Lines of code removed.
- `model_breakdown` (Attributes List) Token usage and estimated cost per model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records--model_breakdown))
- `num_sessions` (Number) Distinct sessions.
- `organization_id` (String) Owning organization id.
- `pull_requests` (Number) Pull requests created through Claude Code.
- `subscription_type` (String) `enterprise` or `team`; null for API customers.
- `terminal_type` (String) Terminal or environment used.
- `tool_actions` (Attributes List) Accepted and rejected proposals per tool, sorted by tool name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records--tool_actions))

<a id="nestedatt--records--model_breakdown"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records.model_breakdown`

Read-Only:

- `cache_creation_tokens` (Number) Cache creation tokens.
- `cache_read_tokens` (Number) Cache read tokens.
- `estimated_cost_amount` (Number) Estimated cost in minor units (cents).
- `estimated_cost_currency` (String) Currency code of the estimate.
- `input_tokens` (Number) Input tokens.
- `model` (String) Model name.
- `output_tokens` (Number) Output tokens.


<a id="nestedatt--records--tool_actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records.tool_actions`

Read-Only:

- `accepted` (Number) Accepted proposals.
- `rejected` (Number) Rejected proposals.
- `tool` (String) Tool name (for example `edit_tool`).
